code='''def transform(grid):
    """Extend shorter repeated horizontal foreground bars with color 1."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # The most frequent value is the background in this task family.
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Horizontal foreground components are separated by at least one background row.
    runs = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if row[c] == bg:
                c += 1
                continue
            color = row[c]
            start = c
            while c < w and row[c] == color:
                c += 1
            runs.append((r, start, c, color))
    if not runs:
        return out
    # Repeated bars share a left alignment and color. Extend each to the right edge
    # reached by the longest such bar, marking only the missing cells.
    groups = {}
    for r, start, end, color in runs:
        groups.setdefault((start, color), []).append((r, end))
    for (start, color), group in groups.items():
        target = max(end for _, end in group)
        if len(group) > 1 or len(runs) > 1:
            for r, end in group:
                for c in range(end, target):
                    if out[r][c] == bg:
                        out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
